layer: V2: DeFi 金融引擎与市场博弈

title.zh: 质押、流动性质押与再质押

summary.zh: 拆解 PoS 质押的真实收益来源、stETH/wstETH 流动性质押机制，以及 LST 循环贷与再质押套娃为何会在轻微脱锚时引发连环清算。
summary.en: How PoS staking yield works, Rebase vs Exchange-Rate LSTs, and why looped LST / Restaking positions blow up on small depegs.

title.zh: 质押生息与流动性质押（LST）沙盒

subtitle.zh: ETH 质押年化 3.5% 是凭空印的还是赚来的？拆解 stETH 余额增长与 wstETH 汇率增长的底层差异。
subtitle.en: Where PoS yield comes from and how Rebase (stETH) vs Reward-Bearing (wstETH) tokens work.

title.zh: LST 循环贷与再质押（Restaking）连环清算模拟器

subtitle.zh: 质押赚 4%、借币花 2.5%，套 8 倍循环贷看起来稳赚 14%？亲手拉动 5% 脱锚看清本金如何瞬间蒸发。
subtitle.en: Simulate how recursive LST looping and stacked AVS slashing amplify tiny depegs into total liquidation.
